name: OS1 Voice Agent
summary: Real-time voice AI. ElevenLabs voice talks to a local Qwen2.5-14B model by default — no cloud LLM API key required. Optionally upgrades to Claude Sonnet if an Anthropic key is supplied. OpenClaw handles background tasks. Persistent Obsidian-backed memory with nightly consolidation.

components.notes: OpenClaw gateway + voice proxy. Default primary model is Qwen2.5-14B; patched to Claude Sonnet by primary-llm component if key is provided.
Optional. If an Anthropic API key is supplied at setup, this component patches the gateway config to use Claude Sonnet as primary instead of Qwen. Qwen stays installed as fallback.
Ollama server. Pulls Qwen2.5-14B (primary or fallback) and nomic-embed-text for memory recall. Always installed.
OpenClaw builtin memory backend + Obsidian wiki + nightly dreaming consolidation.
ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent. Points its custom-llm Server URL at this tenant's gateway.
OS1 React UI for starting/holding the voice conversation.

optionalCredentials.label: Anthropic API key (optional)
optionalCredentials.requiredFor: Upgrade primary LLM from local Qwen2.5-14B to Claude Sonnet
